text:
maya: quick heads-up — we have a cluster of PRs touching sdk, api, console, and helm. need to sequence merges to avoid breakage. SDK PR #1234 (client auth change) blocks API PR #5678; console PR #9012 will be behind a feature flag. can owners/reviewers confirm order and timing?

sam: i'm on SDK PR, finishing tests now. i can get final approvals today. CI flaky on gp2 tests but main tests are green.

liam: API team here — PR #5678 depends on the sdk change. we can hold until sdk is merged; canary is ready. target ETA for merge: today ~5pm PT.

chandra: console side — PR #9012 will be feature-flagged. we need to lock the api endpoint name. @liam is "/v1/internal/client-login" final?

liam: yes that's fine. we added a route alias so both names work for a week to give console time to flip.

marta: helm/runtime note — i need to bump chart version + runtime image tag after console deploy. i'll prepare the chart PR but won't merge until api + console are live.

maya: proposed plan: 1) sam merges sdk after approvals; 2) liam rolls canary + merges api; 3) chandra merges console behind feature flag; 4) marta merges helm/chart. @sam pls ping this thread when sdk is merged.

sam: will do. pinging here when merged :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: CI passed for SDK PR #1234 — all checks are green ✅

sam: merged SDK PR #1234 — tagged v1.3.0-client-auth. @liam please r?

liam: starting canary deploy now, watching logs.

marta: prepping chart PR: https://github.com/redwood/charts/pull/456 — will set it to hold.

chandra: console LGTM after feature flag enabled, will monitor logs for 30m.

liam: canary looks stable, rolling to 2 more hosts.

maya: thanks everyone. quick follow-up: i'll add a note to release notes and create a tiny compatibility blurb for client teams. i'll file that doc and tag the SDK owners.

sam: thanks — great coordination :rocket:
